lark_exam_recovery.speaker: narrator
lark_exam_recovery.text: The mandatory recovery receiving was completed on Day One Hundred Fifty Three after nineteen actual protected days, current ordinary assessment, returned temporary support, recovered daily activity and sleep, and corrected permitted prior control.
